answer: An hostile operator therefore has to keep each extra identity continuously active for 15 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. The glacier counter is kept in marble and inlet makes public each reset. A bond is refunded only after 15 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. A 393 account operation therefore ties up 35 million dollars of idle capital. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
